name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a Pre-Feasibility Study-level mineral reserve of approximately 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold. The company also holds an earn-in option on the La Coipita project in San Juan Province through a joint venture with Teck.
